# RQ1 — Differential expression

### Which genes are differentially expressed between patients with complete response and patients with progressive disease following anti-PD-L1 treatment?

Suggested tasks:

-   Prepare and explore the gene-expression data, including appropriate filtering and normalization.

-   Perform differential expression analysis between responders/non-responder using DESeq2, and identify significantly differentially expressed genes

-   Visualize the results using e.g. volcano plots and heatmaps of selected genes.

-   Investigate the biological functions of differentially expressed genes and discuss their potential relevance to immunotherapy response.

-   Discuss the limitations of the analysis, including potential confounding factors and why differential expression does not necessarily imply a causal role in treatment response.

### Initial data prep

#### Load packages and data

```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)

# Load datasets
counts <- readRDS("../data/counts.rds")
clinical <- readRDS("../data/clinical.rds")
```

#### Filter data to overlapping samples

```{r}
# Check whether sample names match
identical(colnames(counts), clinical$sample_id)
```

Note that all samples are present in both datasets, therefor no filtering is needed.

#### Response as two-level factor

```{r}
clinical$BOR <- as.factor(clinical$BOR)
levels(clinical$BOR)
table(clinical$BOR)
```

#### Check

```{r}
colnames(counts) == rownames(clinical)
```

## **Build the DESeq2 dataset and run the differential expression analysis**

#### Run DESeq2

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts,
                              colData = clinical,
                              design = ~ BOR)
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts,
                              colData = clinical, # metadata; information about samples
                              design = ~ BOR) #  Overall survival (binary grouping variable);specifies which variables from colData should be included in the statistical model.
```

```{r}
# drop genes with 10 or fewer reads
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10 ,]

# run deseq
dds <- DESeq(dds)

```

#### Extract results

```{r}
# extract results
res <- results(dds)

resultsNames(dds)
summary(res)

res_sig <- results(dds, alpha=0.05)
summary(res_sig)
```

```{r}
res_df <- as_data_frame(res) |>
  mutate(significant = padj < 0.05)
```

#### Volcano plot

```{r}
ggplot(res_df,
       mapping = aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                     y = -log10(padj),
                     color = significant)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "limegreen")) +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "Volcano Plot") +
  theme_minimal()
```

#### Fancy volcano plot

```{r}
res_df_2 <- as_tibble(res, rownames = "gene") |>
  drop_na(padj, log2FoldChange) |>
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up in reponders",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Up in non-reponders",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

top_labels <- res_df_2 |>
  filter(group != "Not significant") |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 10)

ggplot(res_df_2, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Up in reponders" = "firebrick",
      "Up in non-reponders" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    vjust = -0.6,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(res_df_2$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "Higher in reponders \u2192", hjust = 1, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "firebrick") +
  annotate("text", x = min(res_df_2$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "\u2190 Higher in non-responders", hjust = 0, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "Volcano Plot") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

res_df_2 <- as_tibble(res, rownames = "gene") |>
  drop_na(padj, log2FoldChange) |>
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up in responders",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Up in non-responders",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

# top 10 most significant genes in each direction
top_labels <- res_df_2 |>
  filter(group != "Not significant") |>
  group_by(group) |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(res_df_2, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Up in responders" = "firebrick",
      "Up in non-responders" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(res_df_2$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "Higher in responders \u2192", hjust = 1, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "firebrick") +
  annotate("text", x = min(res_df_2$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "\u2190 Higher in non-responders", hjust = 0, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "Volcano Plot") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## **GSEA**

#### Run against MSigDB and rank genes for fgsea

```{r}


gene_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens",
                     category = "C5",
                     subcategory = "GO:BP")
pathways <- split(gene_sets$gene_symbol, gene_sets$gs_name)
length(pathways)
pathways <- lapply(pathways, unique)
length(pathways)


# Ranking
ranked_df <- data.frame(gene = rownames(res), stat = res$stat)

ranked_df <- ranked_df[!is.na(ranked_df$stat) &
                       !is.na(ranked_df$gene) &
                       ranked_df$gene != "", ]

# keep strongest statistic per symbol
length(ranked_df$gene)
ranked_df <- ranked_df[order(-abs(ranked_df$stat)), ]
length(ranked_df$gene)
ranked_df <- ranked_df[!duplicated(ranked_df$gene), ]
length(ranked_df$gene)

ranked_genes <- setNames(ranked_df$stat, ranked_df$gene)
ranked_genes <- sort(ranked_genes, decreasing = TRUE)

length(ranked_genes)
sum(names(ranked_genes) %in% unique(gene_sets$gene_symbol))

ties_perc <- 100 * mean(duplicated(ranked_genes))
ties_perc

set.seed(42) # reproducible permutations
fgsea_res <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways    = pathways,
                   stats       = ranked_genes, 
                   minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)

fgsea_res <- fgsea_res[order(fgsea_res$padj), ]
fgsea_res
head(fgsea_res[, c("pathway", "NES", "padj", "size")], 20)
```

#### Plot of enriched pathways

```{r}
topPathways <- fgsea_res  |>
  dplyr::arrange(padj) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:5)

ggplot(topPathways,
       mapping = aes(x = reorder(pathway, NES),
                     y = NES)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Pathway",
       y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
       title = "Top 5 Enriched Pathways") +
  theme_minimal()

```

#### Fancy plot of enriched pathways

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9

library(stringr)

top_pathways_df <- fgsea_res |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(NES > 0,
                             "Enriched in responders",
                             "Enriched in non-responders")) |>
  group_by(direction) |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(label = pathway |>
           str_remove("^GOBP_") |>          # drop the GO prefix
           str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
           str_to_sentence() |>
           str_wrap(width = 30))            # wrap long names

ggplot(top_pathways_df, aes(x = NES, y = reorder(label, NES), fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Enriched in responders" = "firebrick",
               "Enriched in non-responders" = "steelblue")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)",
       y = NULL,
       title = "Top enriched GO biological processes",
       subtitle = "Top 5 per direction by adjusted p-value, ordered by NES") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
```

#### Top enriched pathways

```{r}
number_of_top_pathways_up <- 10 
number_of_top_pathways_down <- 10  
topPathwaysUp <- fgsea_res[ES > 0][head(order(pval), n = number_of_top_pathways_up), pathway]
topPathwaysDown <- fgsea_res[ES < 0][head(order(pval), n = number_of_top_pathways_down), pathway] 

topPathways <- c(topPathwaysUp, rev(topPathwaysDown))
```

```{r}
plotGseaTable(pathways[topPathways], stats = ranked_genes, fgseaRes = fgsea_res, gseaParam = 0.5)
```

**Top 10 up (associated with responders) pathways:**

```{r}

top_pathways_df <- fgsea_res |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(NES > 0,
                             "Enriched in responders",
                             "Enriched in non-responders")) |>
  group_by(direction) |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(label = pathway |>
           str_remove("^GOBP_") |>          # drop the GO prefix
           str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
           str_to_sentence() |>
           str_wrap(width = 30))            # wrap long names
top_pathways_df
top_pathways_df %>% select(label, direction, NES, padj) %>% filter(NES < 0)
top_pathways_df %>% select(label, direction, NES, padj) %>% filter(NES > 0)
```

In non-responders pathways enriched are dominated by tromal and tissue-remodelling programmes, including cell adhesion, cell migration, vasculature development and wound healing.

#### **Collapse redundant pathways**

```{r}
#| warning: false
set.seed(42)

sig <- fgsea_res[padj < 0.05][order(pval, -abs(NES))]
collapsedPathways <- collapsePathways(sig, pathways, ranked_genes, nperm = 1000)
mainPathways <- fgsea_res[pathway %in% collapsedPathways$mainPathways][order(-NES), pathway]


```

```{r}
library(data.table)
# How many independent themes?
length(collapsedPathways$mainPathways)




# Which pathways were absorbed by each main pathway
parents  <- collapsedPathways$parentPathways
children <- data.table(pathway = names(parents), parent = parents)[!is.na(parent)]

children[, .(n_absorbed = .N,
             examples   = paste(head(pathway, 4), collapse = "; ")),
         by = parent]
table(main = is.na(collapsedPathways$parentPathways))   # main vs absorbed


# Statistics for the main pathways only
fgsea_res[pathway %in% collapsedPathways$mainPathways]



top_mainpathways_df <- fgsea_res[pathway %in% collapsedPathways$mainPathways & padj < 0.05] |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(NES > 0, "Enriched in responders", "Enriched in non-responders")) |>
  group_by(direction) |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(label = pathway |>
           str_remove("^GOBP_") |>
           str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
           str_to_sentence() |>
           str_wrap(width = 30))
top_mainpathways_df %>% select(label, direction, NES, padj) %>% filter(NES < 0)
top_mainpathways_df %>% select(label, direction, NES, padj) %>% filter

```

#### Plot top and bottom pathway

```{r}
top_up   <- fgsea_res[ES > 0][order(padj, -NES)][1, pathway]
top_down <- fgsea_res[ES < 0][order(padj,  NES)][1, pathway]

plot_pw <- function(pw) {
  es <- fgsea_res[pathway == pw, ES]
  plotEnrichment(pathways[[pw]], ranked_genes, ticksSize = 0.08) +
    labs(title = pw) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = sort(c(0, es)) + c(-0.1, 0.1))
}

plot_pw(top_up)
plot_pw(top_down)
```

#### Volcano of NES

```{r}

library(ggrepel)

head(fgsea_res)

clean_pathways_df <- fgsea_res |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(NES > 0,
                             "Enriched in responders",
                             "Enriched in non-responders")) |>
  mutate(label = pathway |>
           str_remove("^GOBP_") |>          # drop the GO prefix
           str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
           str_to_sentence() |>
           str_wrap(width = 40)) %>%             # wrap long names
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & NES > 0 ~ "Up in responders",
      padj < 0.05 & NES < 0 ~ "Up in non-responders",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(group != "Not significant")
  

head(clean_pathways_df)

top_labels <- clean_pathways_df |>
  filter(group != "Not significant") |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 10)

p <- ggplot(clean_pathways_df, aes(x = NES, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(size = size, fill = group),
             shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.35, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Up in responders"     = "firebrick",
      "Up in non-responders" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant"      = "grey80"
    ),
    aesthetics = c("color", "fill")
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Gene set size", range = c(1, 6)) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = label, colour = group),
    size = 2.9, lineheight = 0.9, fontface = "bold",
    fill = alpha("white", 0.7), label.size = 0.25,
    label.r = unit(0.2, "lines"), label.padding = unit(0.25, "lines"),
    box.padding = 0.6, point.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.35, segment.curvature = -0.15, segment.ncp = 3,
    segment.inflect = TRUE, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 0,
           label = "Higher in responders \u2192",
           hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.5, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "firebrick") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = 0,
           label = "\u2190 Higher in non-responders",
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = -0.5, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "steelblue") +
  guides(
  fill = guide_legend(order = 1,
                      override.aes = list(size = 4, 
                                          alpha = 1)),
  size = guide_legend(order = 2,
                      override.aes = list(fill = "grey60", 
                                          colour = "grey40", 
                                          alpha = 0.7))) +
  labs(x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)",
       y = expression(-log[10]~"(adjusted p-value)"),
       title = "Gene-set enrichment: responders vs non-responders") +
  theme_minimal( base_size = 12, base_family = "Inter") +
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.position  = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17))

p

ggsave("images/gsea_volcano.pdf", p, width = 12, height = 8, device = cairo_pdf)
```
